items.title: 13.11.3 Factors affecting disinfection (disinfection par asar dalne wale factors) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11.3 with Quick Check 13.6, printed pages 301-302.

items: pH taqreeban 6 se 7.5 ho to HOCl predominate (sab se zyada) hota hai aur disinfection zyada effective (asar wali) hoti hai.
Zyada pH (7.5 se oopar) par OCl⁻ zyada hota hai; yeh kam effective hai lekin phir bhi jaraseem maarta hai.

blocks.text: Chlorine jitni zyada, disinfection utni effective. Itni chlorine dalni zaroori hai ke bacteria maarne ke liye kaafi HOCl aur OCl⁻ ban sakein. (Kitab ne heading mein “Chorine” chhapa hai; matlab chlorine hai.)
Contact time (chlorine aur pani kitni der saath rahen)
Pani aur chlorine ko itni der saath rehna chahiye ke disinfectants bacteria, viruses aur protozoa ke andar ja kar unhen maar sakein.

blocks.caption: Disinfection par asar dalne wale factors
rows: zyada effective HOCl sab se zyada hota hai
kaafi HOCl aur OCl⁻ milte hain
disinfectants ko jaraseem ke andar jane ka waqt milta hai

blocks.prompt: a) Pani mein bacteria maarne ke liye HOCl OCl⁻ se zyada asar-daar disinfectant kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: HOCl par koi charge nahi, is liye yeh bacteria ki cell wall aur membrane se aasani se guzar jata hai. OCl⁻ negative charge wala ion hai aur cell ki surface (satah) ise door dhakelti hai. Andar ja kar HOCl proteins, enzymes aur nucleic acids ko oxidize kar ke cell ko maar deta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Pani mein bacteria ki disinfection par kaun se factors asar dalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Teen: pH (6 se 7.5 par HOCl zyada aur disinfection behtar; 7.5 se oopar OCl⁻ zyada aur kam asar), chlorine ki dose (kaafi amount), aur contact time (kaafi lamba).

blocks.prompt: c) Pani ki chlorination mein primary (asal) active species kaun si hain? Un ke banne ki equation dein.
blocks.explanation: HOCl aur OCl⁻. Cl₂ + H₂O → HCl + HOCl, phir weak acid HOCl thora sa ionize hota hai: HOCl ⇌ H⁺ + OCl⁻.

items: pH 6 se 7.5: HOCl zyada, sab se behtar disinfection; 7.5 se oopar OCl⁻, kam asar.
Chlorine ki dose kaafi ho aur contact time kaafi lamba ho.
